n1.speaker: kai
n1.text: Hi! Are you OK? You look worried. Take a breath. How can I help?

translations.fa: سلام! حالت خوبه؟ نگران به نظر میای. یه نفس بکش. چطور کمکت کنم؟

branches.suggestion: I can't find William! He's three.
branches.suggestionFa: ویلیام را پیدا نمی‌کنم! سه سالشه.

branches.suggestion: A little boy is lost. I was looking after him!
branches.suggestionFa: یه پسر کوچولو گم شده. من مراقبش بودم!

n2.speaker: kai
n2.text: OK. Don't worry, this happens every Saturday. We'll find him. What's his name, and what is he wearing?

translations.fa: باشه. نگران نباش، هر شنبه این اتفاق می‌افته. پیداش می‌کنیم. اسمش چیه و چی پوشیده؟

branches.suggestion: William Tom. He's wearing a red coat.
branches.suggestionFa: ویلیام تام. یه کت قرمز پوشیده.

branches.suggestion: He has a dinosaur hat! And blue wellies.
branches.suggestionFa: یه کلاه دایناسوری داره! و چکمهٔ آبی.

match: he is wear a red coat
recasts.echo: He's wearing a red coat. Good.

n3.speaker: kai
n3.text: Red coat, dinosaur hat. Brilliant, that's easy to spot. When did you last see him? And where?

translations.fa: کت قرمز، کلاه دایناسوری. عالیه، راحت دیده میشه. آخرین بار کی دیدیش؟ کجا؟

branches.suggestion: Five minutes ago, at the toy shop.
branches.suggestionFa: پنج دقیقه پیش، تو مغازهٔ اسباب‌بازی.

branches.suggestion: Near the escalator. I turned around, and he was gone.

cultureNote.en: UK shopping centres have a "lost child" procedure. Staff close the doors and use radios. Go straight to a member of staff.
cultureNote.fa: مراکز خرید برای کودک گم‌شده روال مشخص دارند. فوراً به کارکنان بگویید.

n4.speaker: kai
n4.text: Thanks. I'm calling security on the radio now. "Code Adam. Red coat, dinosaur hat, three years old."

translations.fa: ممنون. الان با بی‌سیم به نگهبانی زنگ می‌زنم. «کد آدام. کت قرمز، کلاه دایناسوری، سه ساله.»

branches.suggestion: Should I go back to the toy shop?

n5.speaker: kai
n5.text: It means "lost child" — all the staff are looking now. Stay here with me. Have you got his parents' number?

translations.fa: یعنی «بچهٔ گم‌شده» — همهٔ کارکنان الان دنبالشن. پیش من بمون. شمارهٔ پدر و مادرش را داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Should I call Leslie now?
branches.suggestionFa: آره. الان به لزلی زنگ بزنم؟

branches.suggestion: His dad is Tom. He's driving the bus.

n6.speaker: kai
n6.text: Wait — my radio. "Boy in a dinosaur hat, found in the sweet shop." Ha! Of course he is. They're bringing him now.

translations.fa: صبر کن — بی‌سیمم. «پسری با کلاه دایناسوری، تو مغازهٔ آبنبات پیدا شد.» ها! معلومه. دارن میارنش.

branches.suggestion: Oh, thank goodness! The sweet shop!
branches.suggestionFa: وای، خدا را شکر! مغازهٔ آبنبات!

branches.suggestion: William! Never run away again, OK?
branches.suggestionFa: ویلیام! دیگه هیچ‌وقت فرار نکن، باشه؟

branches.suggestion: Where did you get a lolly?

n8.speaker: kai
n8.text: The security man gave it to him. Happy ending! Hold his hand now — and maybe don't tell Leslie until you're home.

translations.fa: نگهبانه بهش داد. پایان خوش! حالا دستش را بگیر — شاید هم تا خونه به لزلی نگی.
